notes:
Automatic updates.

New users: download video-grabber-1.9.0.zip, unzip, open START HERE.html.

Already using Video Grabber? Update by hand one last time: replace your folder with this ZIP, click ↻ in chrome://extensions and run the helper setup again (settings → Install the helper). Then go to settings → Updates → "Turn on automatic updates" and load the folder it shows once with "Load unpacked". From then on Video Grabber updates itself.

Also in 1.8: honest Spotify verification (checked by sound or skipped), readable error messages, download queue, "Saved" only after the file is written, renaming for all downloads.
